morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics benefit from falling freight rates and improved fuel substitution options.
what_changed: Units are shifting away from Piped Natural Gas (PNG) as propane supply improves.
Ocean container freight rates for exported ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Major player Somany Ceramics plans a 5 MSM capacity increase via debottlenecking.
improvement_signals: Propane availability has improved, allowing ceramic units to cut PNG consumption and manage fuel expenses [81469af468f3]
Container freight rates plummeted up to 50 percent, providing significant margin relief for exporters [d6c30857de2c]
what_to_watch: Exact price differential between PNG and propane to gauge working capital adjustments.
Target location and funding mix of Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan [0f642d309dd8].
Sustainability of lower ocean freight tariffs across key international trade lanes.

surat.headline: Surat shows diamond demand recovery alongside textile payment stress and supply constraints.
what_changed: Diamond segment sees a demand turnaround after a four-year slump, leading to plans for early unit reopenings.
Position Printing Association mandated a 15% charge hike and a strict 45-day payment window for textile units.
Textile Ministry introduced a national drive to track fabric production capacity across all units.
stress_signals: Organized fraud gangs causing default losses in the textile market, prompting SGCCI to demand GUJCTOC application [421d4bf835f5]
Pre-Diwali shutdowns in diamond cutting and polishing units triggered by a shortage of rough diamonds [b65b93c4b724]
Surat diamond merchant committed suicide in Sagarampura [9edf027a29a8]
Textile demand remains muted while input printing costs rise by 15% with tight 45-day payment terms [d6a824e747af, ad48975ddfcf]
improvement_signals: Surat Textile Policy cleared 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore investment [021c037e28d9]
Diamond jewellery demand recovers after a four-year recession, spurring early unit reopenings [bae3b8d48691, bd78e4a130ff]
MANTRA selected for national textile sustainability project and launched MedTech testing services [8cfd965ad293, 5e7cd22236e9]
what_to_watch: Receivable cycles and working capital pressure on weaving/trade units following the 15% printing hike and 45-day term limit.
Inventory and rough diamond availability to sustain early post-vacation reopening of polishing units.
Compliance with Diwali fire department passage regulations in textile markets to prevent festive operational disruptions.
